get_train_set: get the MNIST training dataset with 60000 examples using Dataset.get_train_set()
get_test_set: get the MNIST test dataset with 10000 examples using Dataset.get_test_set()
num_train_examples: get the number of MNIST training examples using Dataset.num_train_examples()
num_test_examples: get the number of MNIST test examples using Dataset.num_test_examples()
example_to_image: convert an MNIST example tensor to a PIL grayscale image using example_to_image()
